correctness.rationale: PASS: Proposition 9 of Cai–Kiah–Nguyen–Yaakobi (arXiv:2001.01376, p.7 of the PDF) identifies the two-deletion-read ambiguity relation with opposite alternating intervals. Both phases of length at least three cannot avoid 010, so edges reduce exactly to legal swaps. Unique u01v orientation and boundary conditions yield E(z)=z^2(1-z)^2/D(z)^2. The padded local obstruction yields exactly two length-six forbidden patterns; the explicit eleven-state integer polynomial identity (I-zT)X=Qb with X_11=N proves the rational isolated series. The supplied independent direct, transfer and polynomial verifiers all pass. Scope is every nonnegative integer length, with an explicit empty-word convention. No unproved extension is inferred from finite data.

originality.rationale: PASS (qualified): Existing published Type-A classification and unrestricted binary/q-ary edge enumeration give a general description of edges, but do not furnish the induced 010-free graph’s all-length zero-degree language or rational isolated-vertex enumerator. Inspected original arXiv 2001.01376 paper proves pairwise Type-A equivalence, not a forbidden-factor restricted isolated-vertex count. Pattern-avoidance arXiv 1210.7620 treats a balanced-word sublanguage and a different statistic. A published 010-free cyclic three-gram reconstruction result uses rotation classes and full three-gram profiles, not linear single-deletion reads, and does not imply the zero-degree series. Searches for direct formulas and equivalences returned no covering result. Prior-work databases and indexing are incomplete; an earlier unindexed exact enumerator remains possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently described exact 010-avoiding two-read zero-degree count could exist.

The full-space Type-A characterization immediately implies the adjacent-swap observation, so novelty is claimed for the combined constrained zero-degree language and exact rational enumerator, not for the general reconstruction relation.

value.rationale: PASS: The exact number of zero-ambiguity codewords in the natural smallest alternating-triple-forbidden language is a meaningful channel invariant: unlike an edge count alone, it identifies inputs that can be used in every two-read code with no pairwise exclusion. The padded two-forbidden-factor description and compact rational series are an exact all-length structural classification, with an explicit certificate and a locally computable language, not a selected small numerical case. The accompanying edge series and bipartiteness explain the reduction from general nonlocal alternating deletion conflicts to adjacent moves. It does not assert a closed code-capacity formula or broader applications.
